# openwrt_network_wireguard (Resource)

Manages a WireGuard peer in OpenWrt.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `allowed_ips` (List of String) Allowed IPs for this peer (e.g., ['10.0.0.2/32', '192.168.100.0/24']).
- `name` (String) Name of the WireGuard peer (e.g., 'wgclient1').
- `public_key` (String) WireGuard public key of the peer.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description or label for this peer.
- `endpoint_host` (String) Endpoint hostname or IP address.
- `endpoint_port` (Number) Endpoint UDP port (default: 51820).
- `persistent_keepalive` (Number) Persistent keepalive interval in seconds (0 to disable).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: network/<peer_name>.
